label: Immediate refund: maximum per transaction
unit: KRW, upper bound on one purchase
appliesTo: Shoppers using immediate refund at the till, where the tax is deducted before payment
why: Decides at the counter which refund route you are on. A purchase at or above this cannot be handled by deducting the tax on the spot, so it falls back to the ordinary process with a refund slip and a customs step at the airport — which is a different set of things to keep hold of, and a surprise if you assumed the till had settled it.

history.source: Korea Tourism Organization — tax refund guidance
history.note: Immediate refund applies to a single purchase of at least ₩15,000 and under ₩1,000,000. At or above that, use the ordinary post-purchase refund route.
